fusions.name: Mouthful of Loam
fusions.desc: Hurls a clod at the mouth of the first enemy it meets. It deals 10 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Circle Scored in Turf
fusions.desc: Scores a circle into the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their resistances.

fusions.name: Read from the Headstone
fusions.desc: The nearest body within 9.5 tiles rises and fights at your side for 30 seconds. It deals 5 damage a hit.

fusions.name: Said Over the Dead
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
